r.id, r.task_id, r.device_id, r.firmware_id, r.version, r.batch_no, r.status, r.progress, r.verify_status, r.reported_md5, r.message, r.command_id, r.dispatched_at, r.last_report_at, r.created_at, r.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ota_upgrade_record r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id AND d.deleted = 0 JOIN ota_upgrade_task t ON t.id = r.task_id WHERE r.status = #{status} AND d.status = 'ONLINE' AND t.status <> 'ABORTED' ORDER BY r.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM ota_upgrade_record WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'DISPATCHED', 'DOWNLOADING', 'FLASHING', 'VERIFYING') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT r.device_id FROM ota_upgrade_record r JOIN ota_upgrade_task t ON t.id = r.task_id WHERE r.device_id IN #{id} AND r.status IN ('PENDING', 'DISPATCHED', 'DOWNLOADING', 'FLASHING', 'VERIFYING') AND r.task_id <> #{excludeTaskId} AND t.status IN ('RUNNING', 'PAUSED') ORDER BY r.device_id ASC
SELECT id FROM ota_upgrade_record WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id ASC
